name: Frostbite Frenzy
detailed_description:
Slide, smash, and splash in this chaotic multiplayer penguin brawl! Battle your friends on crumbling ice platforms, using quick wits and playful tactics to knock them into the freezing water. The last penguin standing wins!

As a penguin, stay on the icy surface for the longest duration possible. Knock each other down with snowballs, and swiftly reposition yourselves. However, know that the ice you're on is gradually cracking. A block of ice weakens and breaks under sustained weight. You lose if an Orca eats you after you fall in the ocean. The final penguin remaining wins.

Game Features

  • Multiplayer focused gameplay with up to 5 players competing to survive.

  • Wear hats to showcase your status as an elite penguin with appearance customization.

  • Throw snowballs and dash to always change your positioning and to break more ice at a time.
